scope: Original AST token batching/date-delay helpers on synthetic data, no plugin import/LLM/server or user store
observations: Oversized Unicode message splits into estimated-budget-bounded chunks and concatenates without text loss
Budget too small for one character raises ValueError
Same-session memory with missing time suppressed while other-session missing-time memory retained
Precompact same-session memory exempt from recency delay positive control
limits: Budget is heuristic estimated tokens, not provider tokenizer guarantee
